human_handover_response_time_seconds.formula: 本项的实际单位为秒（官方 metrics.schema.json 的 unit 枚举只有 sqm / m / ratio / count / index / none，无时间单位，故按 index 登记，单位由本行与指标键名 `_seconds` 后缀声明）/ Unit: seconds (the official metrics.schema.json unit enum offers only sqm, m, ratio, count, index and none, with no time unit, so this metric is registered as index and its real unit is declared here and by the `_seconds` suffix in the key). median(human_acknowledgement_timestamp - valid_handover_trigger_timestamp)

human_handover_response_time_seconds.reason: No approved exercise, timestamp log, or accountable operator baseline is available.

human_handover_response_time_seconds.exclusions: protocol-invalid triggers only, with count and reason disclosed
human_handover_response_time_seconds.recalculation_trigger: operator, rota, interface, escalation, or service-hours change

assumptions: Role-group coverage does not measure personal ability, diagnosis, identity, or representativeness by headcount.

The protocol role groups extend beyond the six personas: residents along the belt, micro and small merchants at ground-floor frontages, caregivers and adults travelling with children, and early-career talent are named role groups because a renewal process affects them even when they are not the end user of a scenario.

Naming a role group adds no persona row. `persona_count` stays at 6 and the persona table remains the demand framework, while the role groups define who must be at the table before a change is approved.

Every G3 review registers a non-participant impact check: the groups a change may affect but who did not take part in that round, and the channel by which they are informed. A missing check is a stop condition for that round, not a note.
co_design_role_coverage_ratio.reason: No approved ethics protocol, recruitment record, or participant-role structure exists.
co_design_role_coverage_ratio.numerator_definition: protocol-required role groups with at least one voluntary contribution recorded, counted across participants, caregivers where relevant, residents along the belt, micro and small merchants, early-career talent, operators, maintainers, and professionals
co_design_role_coverage_ratio.denominator_definition: all role groups required by the approved co-design protocol for that task, which must include the directly affected non-user groups — residents along the belt, micro and small merchants, caregivers and adults travelling with children, and early-career talent — alongside participant, operator, maintainer, and professional groups
co_design_role_coverage_ratio.exclusions: observers without a recorded contribution; withdrawals remain reported; a role group may never be removed from the denominator because it proved hard to recruit
co_design_role_coverage_ratio.responsible_role: co-design lead, ethics reviewer, and participant representatives
co_design_role_coverage_ratio.recalculation_trigger: task scope, participant group, operating model, or protocol change

spine_to_heritage_corridor_median_offset.formula: median(distance(sample_point(ROAD-001, every 25 m), heritage_corridor_reference_line)) over samples inside the corridor data band
assumptions: Computed from the OpenStreetMap snapshot already inside the package (sha256 855296cd…), not from field measurement, official survey, or planning data; status PROVISIONAL.

The corridor is a positional proxy assembled from the snapshot's 京包线 and 京包客专线 ways; most of its length is a newly built high-speed corridor, so the figure is an order-of-magnitude reference and neither locates the heritage park nor judges the alignment. assumptions: Snapshot convention: the value is computed at the timestamp of the 2026-08-15 bounded OpenStreetMap snapshot (status PROVISIONAL in the readings file). simulation_task_count.formula: count(simulation.json#tasks); one task per in-package scenario card S01-S16
assumptions: One rehearsal task is registered per scenario card, so this count equals scenario_card_count by construction; it registers rehearsal records, not approved pilots or completed user research.
The sixteen cards are drafted test scripts whose establishment is decided card by card at the G2 closed paired test; the count constitutes no requirement coverage.

calculation_metadata.recalculation_trigger: addition, merger, or withdrawal of a rehearsal task in simulation.json

simulation_task_count.claim_scope_zh: 离线合成演练读数，非现场绩效：本项由 simulation.json 的任务台账逐条复算得出，任何人按该文件 method 与 decision_rules 在同一份包上重算可得同一数值。它衡量的是包内既有结构化登记之间是否自洽，衡量不了任何服务在真实场地上的表现。
simulation_task_count.claim_scope_en: An offline synthetic rehearsal reading, not field performance: the value recomputes item by item from the task ledger in simulation.json, and anyone applying that file's method and decision_rules to the same package obtains the same number. It measures whether the structured registrations already in the package are mutually consistent; it measures nothing about how any service performs on a real site.
simulation_task_count.notes_zh: 十六条任务与十六张场景卡一一对应。本项属本包指标体系的第四类——离线可复算演练读数。既有三类为：按临时几何复算的几何类读数、待官方资料确认的读数、以及待现场实测的绩效读数（后者一律保持 unknown）。第四类既不依赖临时几何，也不等待官方资料，更不冒充现场绩效；status 为 known 描述的是复算本身成立，不是任何场景已经成立。
simulation_task_count.notes_en: The sixteen tasks correspond one to one with the sixteen scenario cards. A fourth-class metric in this package: an offline recomputable rehearsal reading. The three existing classes are geometry readings recomputed on provisional geometry, readings awaiting official material, and field performance readings which stay unknown until measured. The fourth class rests on no provisional geometry, waits for no official material and impersonates no field performance; where the status reads known, what is known is the recomputation, not the establishment of any scenario.

simulation_success_rate.formula: count(simulation.json#tasks[] where outcome == "success" or outcome ends with "_success") / count(simulation.json#tasks)
simulation_success_rate.numerator_definition: rehearsal tasks whose outcome is `success` under decision rule DR-3 of simulation.json: dispatch schema valid, audit chain complete, and no premise disproved or carrier no-go registered against the card (S01, S05, S08)
simulation_success_rate.denominator_definition: all sixteen rehearsal tasks registered in simulation.json
assumptions: Success means the card's dispatch chain recomputes in full offline, not that the scenario is approved, built, staffed, or measured on site.

Twelve tasks are registered blocked because stop-condition binding in risk.json currently reaches only S01, S05 and S08, and one task (S04) is registered as a failure because the AI-off continuity premise of OP-04 was returned to unproven by the package's own evidence chain.

The rate sits far below tool_schema_pass_rate=1.0 on purpose: the field-level criteria are met while the institutional layer is not. Closing that gap requires supplying institutional evidence, never adjusting the criteria.

calculation_metadata.recalculation_trigger: any change to an outcome value, a decision rule, or the task set in simulation.json

tool_schema_pass_rate.numerator_definition: rehearsal tasks whose carrying SCENARIO_NODE features all clear the five required fields and two constraint_machine_rule entries of the node_schema component in visual/assets/seb-spec.json (decision rule DR-1)
tool_schema_pass_rate.denominator_definition: all sixteen rehearsal tasks registered in simulation.json
assumptions: This is a field-criteria measure over the ten SCENARIO_NODE features: every node declares an AI-off route that does not fall back on the same system and names a findable human role. It says nothing about those fields being executable on a real site.
Cards S11-S16 hold no node of their own and inherit the verdict by conjunction over the nodes they reuse, so their pass is not an independent verification.

The value 1.0 is the reading of a criterion the package itself publishes and can be re-run offline: `node seb-tabletop-run.js` inside visual/assets replays sixty-two fixtures against the same criteria and exits zero.

calculation_metadata.recalculation_trigger: revision of the node_schema component, of any SCENARIO_NODE dispatch field, or of the task set in simulation.json

audit_completeness.numerator_definition: rehearsal tasks holding all three audit-chain elements under decision rule DR-2 of simulation.json: a non-empty responsible_role and human_handoff on every carrying node, an accepted two-part handover positive for every carrying node, and a stop condition bound directly to the card in risk.json#dimensions[].scenario_links (S01, S05, S08)
audit_completeness.denominator_definition: all sixteen rehearsal tasks registered in simulation.json
assumptions: The binding element counts only direct binding in risk.json; a relation reached indirectly through a node, a work package or a spatial feature is not accepted, so the reading registers the gap rather than filling it by inference.
Thirteen cards, S04 among them, hold no directly bound stop condition. This agrees with the prose, which binds risk, accountability and recovery evidence to the three representative cards only.
Completeness here is document completeness: it confirms that the elements are registered, never that a role is staffed, a handover rehearsed, or a stop decision ever taken.

calculation_metadata.recalculation_trigger: registration or withdrawal of a scenario_links binding in risk.json, of a handover positive in the fixtures, or of a task in simulation.json
